Implemented in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). The program is a self-contained C++20 CLI with no third-party dependencies: it parses request JSON, inspects and renders GEDCOM datasets, folds and re-emits `CONT` payload continuations, validates HEAD/TRLR/xref/pointer rules, and reads/writes GEDZIP archives with built-in base64, CRC32, ZIP parsing, and ZIP writing.

I built it successfully and ran targeted checks for `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, `render_gedzip`, malformed GEDCOM errors, `@`-escaped payload round-trips, and attachment matching for local `FILE` payloads. Running from `output/`, your requested build command works: `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`.
